rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from a continuing education provider recognized by the Board of Registered Nursing
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from CE for the first renewal after passing the national licensing exam (first two years), except the 1-hour implicit bias course.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep certificates for four years.

topics.who: NPs whose primary-care patient population is over 25% aged 65 or older (gerontology, dementia care or care of older patients)
Licensees within the first 2 years after initial licensure

rules.legal_basis: Title 16, California Code of Regulations, Section 1451
rules.notes: No separate NP hour requirement: NPs renew with the RN license (30 contact hours every two years). The 6 gerontology hours are part of the 30. The Board CE page lists no NP pharmacology or controlled-substance renewal hours.
